rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260)
rules.requirement: In Jersey City buildings with 5 or more units, rent increases are limited by the city's Rent Control Ordinance, and landlords must apply for any increase above the allowed amount, such as a capital improvement or hardship increase. If you think your rent is illegal, you can file an Illegal Rent Petition with the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental properties in Jersey City with 5 or more units, unless the property qualifies for another exemption in the ordinance.
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt. The ordinance has other exemptions, but the source does not list them. Owners request those through a Rent Control Exemption Request.

exemption_tests.description: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control.

rules.reason: There was only one candidate, an official city page on the Chapter 260 rent control ordinance, so it became its own record without changes.
